column1: # wave logit-a100-40-01  pool a100-40  1 card at a time (this job type has no CONTRACT.md split)
# submit with:  bcf/logit_wave.sh --check-only bcf/waves/logit/logit-a100-40-01.tsv
#               bcf/logit_wave.sh              bcf/waves/logit/logit-a100-40-01.tsv
# WHY THIS SITS IN bcf/waves/logit/ AND NOT IN bcf/waves/. bcf/check_wave_manifests.py and
# tests/test_wave_plan.py glob bcf/waves/*.tsv (not recursively) and treat every file they
# find that is not enrich-, ladder- or -resub- as SWEEP CELL rows of the 216-cell grid.
# A model row put beside them would be counted as a cell whose substrate is 'GPU=a100-40'.
# The subdirectory is what keeps this manifest out of that count; those two files are not
# edited by this lane.
# Job B of docs/OUTCOME-SCALE-NOTE.md part 4.5: the logit-level generation pass over the 18
# cells of docs/CELLS18-FITS.md. ONE ROW PER MODEL, because one server does all of that
# model's cells; the rows go out one at a time under the caps in bcf/logit_wave.sh.
# columns: MODEL <tab> KEY=VALUE ...   (order does not matter; the last field is not special)
#   GPU= MEM= CPUS= TIME= are consumed by the wave script; everything else is exported.
# The cell directories are absolute paths on this account's results root
# ($HOME/bcf/results), which is where bcf/serve_and_run.sbatch wrote them and where
# experiments/cells18_fits.py reads them. A tilde or a $VAR would travel into --export
# unexpanded and the job would look for a directory named '~'.
# Serving mode of record (ruling R1, A3.6): VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1, 32 requests in flight,
# VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0, seed 7, chat template {"enable_thinking": false}, the
# revision pinned per row and re-checked against every cell's own run_meta.json.
# A LIMIT worth reading before the numbers are: the 18 text-level cells were not all
# generated on one card type (11 on a MIG 3g.40gb slice of an A100 80GB, 7 on a whole
# a100-80; source each cell's run_meta.json "gpu"). One server per model means all six of a
# model's logit-level reads share ONE card type, whichever this wave allocates, so the read
# and the run it augments do not always share a card. The pass records its own serving mode
# in $BCF_RESULTS/logit-pass/<model>/run_meta.json; nothing here hides the difference.
